name: iac-plan-review
description: One role, one pipeline and two skills for infrastructure change review that refuses to review a plan it did not produce, and treats the plan itself as code execution because on this domain's facts it is.

skills.name: plan-explain
skills.line: Explains a plan from the plan file alone, every sentence carrying a verbatim resource address; a resource it cannot classify as stateful is unknown, never assumed stateless, and it never concludes safe or no downtime.

skills.name: drift-report
skills.line: Attributes drift only to a quoted audit-log record with an event id, time and principal; everything else is unattributed. It proposes no state surgery and reads exit code 1 as an error, never as no drift.
